claim: UPDATE acp_task_titles SET state='claimed',token=? WHERE task_id=? AND state='pending' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM managed_tasks t WHERE t.id=task_id AND t.provider=? AND t.project_id IS ? AND t.title='' AND t.archived=0)
owned: SELECT 1 FROM acp_task_titles WHERE task_id=? AND state='claimed' AND token=?
finish: UPDATE acp_task_titles SET state='done',token=NULL WHERE task_id=? AND state='claimed' AND token=?
write: UPDATE managed_tasks SET title=? WHERE id=? AND title='' AND archived=0
